address: 2F, InterContinental Pudong Hotel, 777 Zhangyang Road, Pudong, Shanghai, Chinese Mainland
bio: With a combination of Jiangzhe motifs and modern sensibility, the space exudes understated luxury. The owner was a food supplier and is picky about freshness and quality. All dishes – à la carte, set menus or seasonal creations – centre on the freshest catch from the East China Sea and sustainable produce from Ningbo. Standouts are the deeply flavoursome swimmer crab with rice cake and the silky, umami-laden braised pomfret with fish roe.
